title: The Bazaar Russian Translation Glossary
description: Canonical Russian translations for all gameplay terms. ENFORCE strictly during translation. Inconsistency between Burn/Поджог/Горение is the #1 quality issue.
rules: Use ONLY the canonical Russian for terms listed in `terms` and `item_types` — never deviate.
Preserve ALL placeholders verbatim: {ability.0}, {ability.1}, {aura.1}, {tier.0}, {0}, etc. Do not translate, reorder, or rewrite them.

Preserve number-of-seconds pluralization. English: 'for {x} second(s).' → Russian: 'на {x} сек.' (use 'сек.' to avoid Russian plural agreement issues; ALL contexts use 'сек.', never секунду/секунды/секунд).
Use formal 'вы' (плюр.) — never 'ты'. Verbs always in 3rd person plural when subject is 'вы': 'вы используете', not 'вы используешь'.

ALL card titles MUST be translated into Russian — even if they look like proper nouns or brand-like names. Translate by meaning: 'Med Kit' → 'Аптечка', 'Kitchen Scale' → 'Кухонные весы', 'Shrinking Potion' → 'Зелье уменьшения', 'Pyre' → 'Костёр', 'Battle Drone' → 'Боевой дрон'. Only HERO names stay English (Vanessa, Dooley, Stelle, …) — those are explicitly listed in hero_names_keep_english.
When a translation needs to mention a card item, use the Russian name from the per-batch card_names mapping if provided; otherwise translate the English item name into idiomatic Russian.
Avoid English borrowings if Russian equivalent exists ('damage' → 'урон', not 'дамаг').
Keep translations within ±30% of source length so UI doesn't break.

Charge.context: когда говорится Charge this — 'Зарядить этот предмет'

Hand.context: В Bazaar 'Hand' = игровая доска предметов, НЕ рука

hero_names_rule: Hero names are ALWAYS kept in English: Vanessa, Dooley, Stelle, Pygmalien, Mak, Jules, Karnok, Vae'rynn. Never transliterate to Ванесса/Дули/etc.
card_names_rule: When the translation references a specific card-item by its English name (e.g. 'Billboard', 'Space Laser'), use the corresponding Russian name from the card_names dictionary provided per-batch. Card names that do NOT appear in that dictionary should be kept in English as a fallback.

forbidden.Когда вы замедляетесь: WRONG: 'Slow' here is verb 'to slow others', not 'to be slowed'. Use 'Когда вы замедляете'.
forbidden.Когда вы защищаете: WRONG: 'Shield' is to gain shield, not 'to defend'. Use 'Когда вы заряжаете щит'.
forbidden.заряжает себя: WRONG: 'Charge this' = 'Зарядить этот предмет', not reflexive.

examples.en: When you use a Weapon, your items gain +{ability.1} Damage for the fight.
examples.ru: Когда вы используете Оружие, ваши предметы получают +{ability.1} к урону до конца боя.

examples.en: The first time each fight you Burn, this gains +{ability.1} Damage for the fight.
examples.ru: В первый раз за бой, когда вы поджигаете, этот предмет получает +{ability.1} к урону до конца боя.

examples.en: Shield equal to 10% of this item's value.
examples.ru: Щит, равный 10% от стоимости этого предмета.

examples.en: When you Heal, gain +{ability.0} Regen for {ability.1} second(s).
examples.ru: Когда вы исцеляете, получите +{ability.0} к регенерации на {ability.1} сек.
